intro: Liechtenstein's culture is Alpine and closely linked to Austria and Switzerland.

chapters.title: Art and stamps
text: The princely family owns one of the world's great private art collections. Liechtenstein's postage stamps are prized by collectors.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: Village festivals, brass bands and Alpine cheese dishes are part of local life.

items.name: National Day
items.text: 15 August, with the Prince's garden party.
